root_cause: Fresh persistence datasets return KaggleHub BackendError with canonical NOT_FOUND envelope (errors=[Not found], error.code=5, wasSuccessful=false). The predecessor absence classifier accepted only explicit HTTP 404, so all three workers failed closed before GPU training.
fix_scope: Persistence absence classifier only; accept HTTP 404 OR the exact canonical KaggleHub BackendError NOT_FOUND envelope. Authentication, network, malformed, permission and generic errors remain fail-closed.
